comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector; record zeros a robot joint and installs a calibration pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate inserts a blade under a tab while controlling a wire; record gravity-supports a link while aligning and inserting a transverse pin.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires intact selective extraction; record requires the link at its zero mark with the pin home, released, and still.
comparison.reason: The record tests load-bearing joint positioning and cross-hole pinning, not latch-mediated terminal extraction.
